select * from ( select t.column_name, (select FROM_COLUMN_VALUE from hls_standard_history where standard_history_id = t.min_line_id) as before_value, (select TO_COLUMN_VALUE from hls_standard_history where standard_history_id = t.max_line_id) as after_value from ( select (select hdlc.prompt from hls_doc_layout_config hdlc where hdlc.layout_code = 'PRJ001F1_CHANGE' and hdlc.tab_code = 'F_PRJ_BASIC' and hdlc.column_name = h.column_name and rownum = 1) as column_name, min(h.standard_history_id) as min_line_id, max(h.standard_history_id) as max_line_id from hls_standard_history h where layout_code = 'PRJ001F1_CHANGE' and tab_code = 'F_PRJ_BASIC' and h.table_name = 'HLS_CREDIT_LINE_CHANCE' and h.table_pk_value = #{chanceId} group by h.column_name ) t ) where before_value != after_value

'CHANCE.FACTORING_RECOURSE' AND sc.code_value = hclc.factoring_recourse ) factoring_recourse_n, hclc.factoring_open, ( SELECT sc.meaning FROM sys_code_value_b_v sc WHERE sc.code = 'CHANCE.FACTORING_OPEN' AND sc.code_value = hclc.factoring_open ) factoring_open_n, hclc.industry, hclc.industry_type, ( SELECT hsc.description FROM hls_stat_class hsc WHERE to_char( hsc.class_id ) = hclc.industry_type AND hsc.enabled_flag = 'Y' ) industry_type_n, hclc.description, hclc.credit_measures, hclc.finance_note, hclc.prj_info_desc, hclc.creditor_analyse, hclc.debtor_analyse, hclc.other_desc, hclc.meeting_type, ( SELECT sc.meaning FROM sys_code_value_b_v sc WHERE sc.code = 'CHANCE.MEETING_TYPE' AND sc.CODE_VALUE = hclc.meeting_type ) meeting_type_n, nvl(( SELECT count(*) FROM hls_credit_line_chance_approver hclca where hclca.chance_id = hclc.chance_id and hclca.vote_status = '10'),0) pass_num, nvl(( SELECT count(*) FROM hls_credit_line_chance_approver hclca where hclca.chance_id = hclc.chance_id and hclca.vote_status = '20'),0) no_pass_num, nvl(( SELECT count(*) FROM hls_credit_line_chance_approver hclca where hclca.chance_id = hclc.chance_id and hclca.vote_status = '30'),0) condition_pass_num FROM hls_credit_line_chance hclc
hclc.chance_id = #{chanceId}

SELECT hclc.chance_id, hclc.meeting_type, ( SELECT sc.meaning FROM sys_code_value_b_v sc WHERE sc.code = 'CHANCE.MEETING_TYPE' AND sc.CODE_VALUE = hclc.meeting_type ) meeting_type_n FROM hls_credit_line_chance hclc
hclc.chance_id = #{chanceId}

SELECT hclc.chance_id, ( SELECT quotation_id FROM prj_quotation pq WHERE pq.source_document_category = 'HLS_CREDIT_LINE_CHANCE' AND pq.source_document_id = hclc.chance_id ) quotation_id, hclc.credit_line_number, hclc.credit_line_name, hclc.bp_id, ( SELECT bp_name FROM hls_bp_master hbm WHERE hbm.bp_id = hclc.bp_id ) bp_id_n, hclc.credit_flag, ( SELECT sc.meaning FROM sys_code_value_b_v sc WHERE sc.code = 'GT.HCLC.CREDIT_FLAG' AND sc.code_value = hclc.credit_flag ) credit_flag_n, hclc.credit_line_amt, hclc.industry, hclc.proposer_employee_id, ( SELECT su.description FROM sys_user su WHERE su.user_id = hclc.PROPOSER_EMPLOYEE_ID ) PROPOSER_EMPLOYEE_ID_N, hclc.project_assistant, ( SELECT su.description FROM sys_user su WHERE su.user_id = hclc.PROJECT_ASSISTANT ) project_assistant_n, hclc.credit_line_status, ( SELECT scv.MEANING FROM sys_code_b sc, sys_code_value_b scv WHERE sc.CODE_ID = scv.CODE_ID AND sc.CODE = 'CREDIT.APPROVE_STATUS' AND scv.value = hclc.credit_line_status ) credit_line_status_n, hclc.creation_date, hclc.approved_date FROM hls_credit_line_chance hclc
1 = 1 and hclc.document_type = 'FACTORING' and hclc.document_category = 'HLS_CREDIT_LINE_CHANCE'
and hclc.credit_line_number like concat('%', concat(#{creditLineNumber},'%'))
and hclc.credit_line_name like concat('%', concat(#{creditLineName},'%'))
and ( SELECT bp_name FROM hls_bp_master hbm WHERE hbm.bp_id = hclc.bp_id ) like concat('%', concat(#{bpName},'%'))
and hclc.industry like concat('%', concat(#{industry},'%'))
and hclc.creation_date >= to_date(#{creationDateFrom},'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss')
and hclc.creation_date < to_date(#{creationDateTo},'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss')+1
and hclc.credit_line_status = #{creditLineStatus}
and hclc.credit_flag = #{creditFlag}
and ( SELECT bp_name FROM hls_bp_master hbm WHERE hbm.bp_id = hclc.bp_id ) like concat('%', concat(#{bpIdN},'%'))
order by hclc.creation_date desc

SELECT t.meeting_type, NVL(NUMBER_PASSERS, 0) AS NUMBER_PASSERS, NVL(NUMBER_FAILURES, 0) AS NUMBER_FAILURES, NVL(NUMBER_CONDITIONA, 0) AS NUMBER_CONDITIONA, CASE WHEN NUMBER_PASSERS > NUMBER_FAILURES AND NUMBER_PASSERS > NUMBER_CONDITIONA THEN '通过' WHEN NUMBER_FAILURES > NUMBER_CONDITIONA AND NUMBER_FAILURES > NUMBER_PASSERS THEN '不通过' WHEN NUMBER_CONDITIONA > NUMBER_PASSERS AND NUMBER_CONDITIONA > NUMBER_FAILURES THEN '有条件通过' END AS VOTING_RESULT FROM ( SELECT c.chance_id, c.meeting_type, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM hls_credit_line_chance_approver cv WHERE cv.vote_status = 10 AND cv.chance_id = c.chance_id) AS NUMBER_PASSERS, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM hls_credit_line_chance_approver cv WHERE cv.vote_status = 20 AND cv.chance_id = c.chance_id) AS NUMBER_FAILURES, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM hls_credit_line_chance_approver cv WHERE cv.vote_status = 30 AND cv.chance_id = c.chance_id) AS NUMBER_CONDITIONA FROM hls_credit_line_chance c where chance_id=#{chanceId} ) t

SELECT hclc.chance_id, ( SELECT quotation_id FROM prj_quotation pq WHERE pq.source_document_category = 'HLS_CREDIT_LINE_CHANCE' AND pq.source_document_id = hclc.chance_id ) quotation_id, hclc.credit_line_number, hclc.credit_line_name, hclc.bp_id, ( SELECT bp_name FROM hls_bp_master hbm WHERE hbm.bp_id = hclc.bp_id ) bp_id_n, hclc.credit_flag, ( SELECT sc.meaning FROM sys_code_value_b_v sc WHERE sc.code = 'GT.HCLC.CREDIT_FLAG' AND sc.code_value = hclc.credit_flag ) credit_flag_n, hclc.credit_line_amt, hclc.industry, hclc.proposer_employee_id, ( SELECT su.description FROM sys_user su WHERE su.user_id = hclc.PROPOSER_EMPLOYEE_ID ) PROPOSER_EMPLOYEE_ID_N, hclc.project_assistant, ( SELECT su.description FROM sys_user su WHERE su.user_id = hclc.PROJECT_ASSISTANT ) project_assistant_n, hclc.credit_line_status, ( SELECT scv.MEANING FROM sys_code_b sc, sys_code_value_b scv WHERE sc.CODE_ID = scv.CODE_ID AND sc.CODE = 'CREDIT.APPROVE_STATUS' AND scv.value = hclc.credit_line_status ) credit_line_status_n, hclc.creation_date, hclc.approved_date, hclc.document_type FROM hls_credit_line_chance hclc
1 = 1
and hclc.credit_line_number like concat('%', concat(#{creditLineNumber},'%'))
and hclc.credit_line_name like concat('%', concat(#{creditLineName},'%'))
and ( SELECT bp_name FROM hls_bp_master hbm WHERE hbm.bp_id = hclc.bp_id ) like concat('%', concat(#{bpName},'%'))
and hclc.industry like concat('%', concat(#{industry},'%'))
and hclc.creation_date >= to_date(#{creationDateFrom},'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss')
and hclc.creation_date < to_date(#{creationDateTo},'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss')+1
and hclc.credit_line_status = #{creditLineStatus}
and hclc.credit_flag = #{creditFlag}
and ( SELECT bp_name FROM hls_bp_master hbm WHERE hbm.bp_id = hclc.bp_id ) like concat('%', concat(#{bpIdN},'%'))
order by hclc.creation_date desc

SELECT t1.MESSAGE_ FROM act_hi_comment t1 , act_hi_actinst t2, hls_credit_line_chance hclc WHERE t2.PROC_INST_ID_ = t1.PROC_INST_ID_ AND t2.TASK_ID_ = t1.TASK_ID_ and t2.ACT_ID_ = #{nodeId} AND t1.TYPE_ = 'comment' and t2.PROC_INST_ID_ = #{wflId} and hclc.chance_id = #{chanceId}
